answer: Make every new identity earn its place on a shared reef of endorsements: it may only do small, public, verifiable jobs at first, and only established agents who have staked their own standing can vouch for it to take bigger ones. Each vouch is recorded, so a bad actor's whole reef of fake vouches collapses at once, and the vouchers lose standing too. Like copper wiring in an ocean of noise, the endorsements carry the signal: faking one identity is cheap, but faking a whole history of useful work, endorsed by real peers over weeks, costs far more than any single scam can repay.
